requirements.statement: Maintain one canonical inventory and source owner for every Estimate Sheet and Component Template action and state.
Area tree CRUD, DnD, delete/restore, lazy loading, and route selection preserve valid topology.
Tab and center-sheet shell operations preserve topology, order, selection, totals, and partial-tree meaning.
Row CRUD, duplicate, move, replace, delete/restore, and input commits preserve row-owned state and authoritative history.
Component and variant edits obey Library, Project, express, and stable-variant ownership boundaries.
Library and folder lifecycle includes explicit archive, a 400-dependent interactive permanent-delete ceiling, nesting, attachment, audit, and cache semantics.

Template and reusable Project source insertion is all-or-nothing per intent, any-selected-node target-valid, identity-fresh, ordered, acknowledged, idempotent, and contained in one inclusive at-most-1000-statement D1 batch.
Legacy and Client Portal issuance project equivalent authoring meaning from one accepted project publication revision and commit-time guarded persistence without leaking private state.

Component Templates are detached workspace blueprints whose graph writes, bounded browse/detail, lifecycle, editor CRUD, composition, variant/provenance trust, explicit availability, operational receipts, and deletion are atomic, topology-valid, and non-propagating.

D1 mutations enforce workspace/project/estimate/tab/node/template ownership, non-null object snapshots, row and publication revisions, idempotency, atomic history/outbox/receipts, statement ceilings, and valid recovery.
Upload, asset, attachment, Images/R2 object, and cleanup state remain ownership-valid and recoverable.
Server actions authorize workspace/project/estimate/template/resource scope and issued/public data exposes no private IDs, snapshots, or storage paths.
Inputs, DnD, confirmations, pending/conflict/offline states, retries, focus, and rollback show exact object state.
Dense inline rename preserves parent surface, geometry, keyboard focus, and consistent commit behavior while compact source filters use transparent triggers and accessible opaque menus.
Favorite set and unset is account and workspace scoped, idempotent, item reconciled, and preserves unrelated preferences.
Tree/sidebar/Template loading, bulk/shared fan-out, copy, and partial data remain bounded and correctly scoped.
Rename drafts and loaded source-family toggles remain render-, network-, and layout-local while preserving continuity and existing deferred, bounded, and virtualized paths.
Cache, history/outbox, Template-library audit policy, migration parity, environment identity, cleanup, and evidence freshness are explicit.

risks.statement: Invalid node/tab/folder topology can orphan or misplace rows, copied subtrees, and Library folders.
Permanent component deletion can partially destroy data or omit non-restorable audit evidence.
D1 upload metadata and R2/Images objects can drift or delete referenced assets.
Preflight-only revision, fingerprint, or correlation checks allow concurrency duplicates and stale writes.

Legacy and Client Portal readers/serializers can mix source revisions, issue different authoring meaning, produce unstable semantic identity, or expose controlled data through direct or derived fields.
Concurrent dirty work and non-executable source/diff evidence freshness can preserve false completion claims.
Client-supplied IDs or public projections can cross workspace, project, estimate, or privacy boundaries.
Template lifecycle behavior can drift across save, bounded browse, editor, source/variant fields, insertion, and shared command contracts when ownership or evidence is split.

criteria.test_rationale: Document, path, and static validation are the decisive evidence for inventory and trace completeness.
Direct D1 topology and mutation receipts are the decisive evidence for the tree contract.
Deep topology read-back and scoped static evidence are decisive for tab and shell integrity.
The exact optional row and concurrency command is listed in IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md; required D1, latch-state, read-back, and static receipts remain independent of test authorization.
Affected-row receipts, uniqueness queries, and scoped loading reconciliation are decisive for ownership scope.
Destructive atomic component delete is a critical invariant; cheaper non-test evidence is insufficient to prove stale-preview and failure atomicity.
The exact optional insertion command is listed in IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md; required D1 receipt, statement-count, zero-write, and authoritative read-back evidence remains independent.
The exact optional publication command is listed in IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md; required writer-registry, revision-fence, zero-write, privacy, and totals receipts remain independent.
Direct local D1 integrity and mutation receipts are decisive for the database criterion.
Environment-scoped D1 and R2 lifecycle receipts are decisive for storage ownership integrity.
Server authorization receipts and an issued-field privacy audit are decisive for this criterion.
User-visible state reconciliation is a critical invariant; cheaper non-test evidence is insufficient to prove real interaction timing.
Query, fan-out, and scoped loading receipts are decisive for the boundedness criterion.
Integrated three-surface MVP behavior is a critical invariant; cheaper non-test evidence is insufficient to prove the route end to end.
The exact optional Template lifecycle command is listed in IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md; required D1 graph, activity, fallback, provenance, cache, and static receipts remain independent.
Required source, class, and DOM ownership receipts prove local implementation; the exact optional UX command and browser visual walkthrough require explicit authorization.
Required source, diff, dependency, and ownership receipts prove local implementation; the exact optional UX command and browser profiler/network walkthrough require explicit authorization.
Direct preference-row before and after reads plus authoritative item-scoped reconciliation are decisive for this auxiliary criterion.

units.goal: Freeze current source, dirty-fix, schema, binding, incident, and UX interaction truth.
Make row CRUD, move, restore, duplicate, replace, and input commits authoritative.
Repair tab/tree topology and make Area and tab rename stable and render-isolated.
Finish component lifecycle and align Library and project-group rename behavior.
Make Template and Project-source insertion target-correct while streamlining source filtering.
Repair D1/R2/Images metadata integrity and collect environment-scoped provider evidence.
Align legacy and Client Portal issued projections with authoring.
Harden Template lifecycle plus Template rename, filter, and menu coherence.
Reconcile every action, finding, environment, UX/performance contract, and criterion into a truthful release decision.

decisions.decision: Keep the stable folder path and use the canonical Estimate Sheet MVP title.

Permanent Library delete removes at most 400 combined dependent Estimate and Template rows after exact preview and is explicitly irreversible; larger interactive impact refuses before mutation and offers Archive.
Selected variant is row-owned; component and variant definition edits are stable-identity shared mutations.

This pack owns authoring-to-issued parity through a monotonic project publication revision, complete same-batch writer increments, bounded read and reread, guarded zero-write issue persistence, and deterministic semantic identity, but not the full recipient lifecycle.
This pack is the sole active authority for the full Component Template lifecycle; the absorbed source pack is removed only after complete crosswalk and validator-backed integration.

Source, static, local D1, browser, preview, hosted, and public evidence are separate classes; user-gated browser, profiler, network, screenshot, and automated-test proof cannot become a hidden local implementation blocker.
Template and reusable Project sources use the current any-selected-node target contract, derive estimate and tab from that node, and reject the whole intent before mutation if any source is invalid.
Every active row starts at revision one; linked states require a source ID, unlinked requires null, and detached retains historical source ID while leaving live Library ownership and fan-out.

Retry identity is separate from source and target identity; one intent mutates once, a client latch retains that intent through ambiguous outcomes, and a deliberate second copy uses a new intent ID only after terminal release.

Template creation commits its header, initial node, copied rows, and operational receipt in one hard D1 batch within the inclusive 1000-statement ceiling; compensating delete is not an atomicity substitute.
Templates remain detached by value; insertion preserves the exact selected variant and current selected price, with an explicit unavailable-price fallback.

Pricing provenance uses recorded, inherited_snapshot, synthesized_fallback, or missing across Estimate, Template, Project-source, health, and publication contracts; duplicate and restore preserve it, it stays private, and no isolated read deletion is accepted.

Dense inline rename preserves the parent surface and geometry, focuses at the caret end without whole-value auto-selection, saves with Enter or deduplicated blur, cancels with Escape, and never saves from pointer exit.

The Templates source-family filter uses a compact transparent trigger with All sources, Custom templates, and Project sources labels; its popup remains opaque and accessible without a persistent selected-row fill.

Preserve existing deferred search, bounded Template hydration, and thresholded virtualization while enforcing local targets below 100ms, a 200ms ceiling, zero unrelated rerenders, requests, remounts, geometry delta, and intended bundle growth; add no performance dependency.

Production Template reads return explicit schema-unavailable state instead of seed fallback, the uncalled row-reorder export is deleted, and committed lifecycle intents use existing component_library_telemetry_events as one bounded operational receipt.
Favorite durability is auxiliary UX-003 and AC-018 work in UNIT-004 and does not gate core MVP implementation or release status.

Single-line Estimate Sheet inputs save on Enter; true multiline textareas alone use Enter for newline and Mod+Enter to save. Template and Project-source intents use one inclusive at-most-1000-statement batch and never chunk.

evidence_index.method: Current route/source action inventory with artifact and scoped-worktree fingerprint comparison.
evidence_index.expected_signal: Every discoverable action has one owner/status and historical completion claims are not reused.
evidence_index.actual_signal: The 133-row matrix is current at the observed scoped source revision; product behavior is not proven.

evidence_index.method: Current source, migration, binding, graph-impact, and incident review grouped by mutation boundary.
evidence_index.expected_signal: Every ranked finding has current evidence and no stale premise is preserved.
evidence_index.actual_signal: Twenty-four findings remain traceable; corrected premises and unresolved evidence gaps are explicit.

evidence_index.method: Create-Implementation-Prompt compilation plus dependency, owner-path, decision, acceptance, evidence, recovery, and next-state review for every remediation unit.
evidence_index.expected_signal: Every unit has dependency closure, fixed routine decisions, one executable minimal-fix sequence, exact evidence authority, recovery, and next state.
evidence_index.actual_signal: Nine units are READY as planning units after the implementation-authoring pass; core and auxiliary work are explicit and none is implemented or product-verified.

evidence_index.expected_signal: No orphan ID or invalid status tuple and every criterion remains truthful.
evidence_index.actual_signal: All eighteen criteria remain FAIL; seventeen core criteria and auxiliary AC-018 are reciprocally traced, and package, implementation, release, artifact hashes, and stale-to-reprove transitions pass canonical validation.

evidence_index.method: Five bounded read-only audit clusters plus integrator synthesis and adversarial review of root cause, blast radius, options, and recovery.
evidence_index.expected_signal: Every F-001 through F-024 has a corrected premise, failure/race/partial-failure simulation, selected smallest coherent repair, rejected alternatives, decisive evidence, and residual risk.
evidence_index.actual_signal: All twenty-four findings are covered; five stale premises and three partial/source-fix dispositions are corrected without product-code changes.

evidence_index.method: Full source-pack artifact and manifest review, current-source spot checks, requirement/finding/unit/evidence crosswalk, and path/reference validation.
evidence_index.expected_signal: All source requirements, findings, units, evidence claims, architecture, flow, and variant contracts are retained with no duplicate active authority.
evidence_index.actual_signal: All eight source requirements, ten findings, four source units, and eight evidence claims are retained under one destination authority; the absorbed source folder is absent, the destination revalidates, and product implementation remains unproven.

evidence_index.method: Read-only live-route inspection plus current-source review of Area, tab, folder, project-group, Template filter, shared dropdown, tree-render, deferred-search, bounded-hydration, and virtualization paths.
evidence_index.expected_signal: Rename and compact-filter behavior has one stable interaction contract, exact local budgets, current strengths, owners, and an explicit required-versus-user-gated proof split.
evidence_index.actual_signal: Nine UI/performance findings, two core requirements, two failing criteria, exact latency/rerender/network/geometry/dependency budgets, six unit owners, required static receipts, and optional browser receipts are defined without product-code changes.
